rules.title: DO生命周期与Alarm重新调度
rules.candidate_trigger: constructor/onStart/初始化hook调用setAlarm，或间接调用调度器。
rules.native_control_limit: One scheduled alarm per object does not cap future alarm invocations; deleteAlarm is object runtime API.
rules.recommendation: 用官方Alarm行为核验；deleteAlarm是对象内操作，不是账户级停用；优先寻找实际可用平台控制，禁止捏造pause接口。

samples.contract: 对象每次重新激活都安排下一轮健康检查；没有工作仍读取全表并继续调度。
一次性任务只有持久化待办才安排Alarm；完成后不重启；重新激活测试不产生额外业务扫描。
SDK的onStart语义或调度实现不在仓库，无法确定激活是否安排新任务。

implementation.static: AST stub RPC activation → local constructor → alarm → storage → rearm; DO-owned schema required
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: workerd activation/alarm/eviction, getAlarm null and empty-work tests
implementation.unsupported: External activation/history, Agents SDK internals and conditional schema initialization

rules.title: 后台逻辑任务无进展或预算重置
rules.candidate_trigger: alarm/RPC/后台循环显式重调度、catch后setAlarm或在内存里保存attempts。
rules.native_control_limit: Single-event CPU and platform failure retries do not cap application-created alarms or SQL row usage.
rules.recommendation: 认可真实的单次资源限制，但不得将CPU限制解释成SQL读写或月费上限；原生覆盖不足时报告缺口。

samples.contract: 处理失败后创建新Alarm并把尝试次数重置；对象重启后重新获得完整尝试预算。
有限任务持久化attempts/progress；空任务停止；合法周期任务具有被执行的频率、单次工作量及实例数边界。
仅在配置中声明每分钟上限，但没有代码或平台执行证据。

implementation.static: AST memory field/constructor reset plus alarm reschedule; persistent get guard distinguished
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: workerd eviction resets attempts while durable runs persist; finite task and periodic window
implementation.unsupported: General transaction/fault invariants and arbitrary counter names require Agent evidence

rules.title: 预览环境与对象数量放大
rules.candidate_trigger: CI为PR/分支生成Worker、binding、Namespace、对象ID或启动后台任务。
rules.native_control_limit: Preview URLs do not imply separate namespaces. Removing a route does not stop existing background alarms.
rules.recommendation: 优先已核实的环境/触发器配置控制；禁止以删除持久化Namespace作为默认清理或隔离。

samples.contract: 每次预览都创建独立后台执行者，PR结束没有停止机制或资源存续预算。
核验实际生成配置；预览不启动后台任务，或具有有界环境/对象数量、到期失活与验收记录。
只能看到模板，生成配置和生产/预览绑定关系缺失。

implementation.static: AST newUniqueId plus activated class alarms; real JSONC/TOML environment bindings
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Config drift/generator gaps; bounded shared/independent-resource models
implementation.unsupported: Live namespace counts and expiry; no claim that a preview URL creates resources

rules.title: 读取扫描放大与迁移丢失索引
rules.candidate_trigger: 热路径SQL、JOIN/ORDER BY、LIMIT、ORM变更或索引迁移。
rules.native_control_limit: LIMIT and returned rows do not bound scanned rows; plans and consumed-cursor metrics are required.
rules.recommendation: 使用原生计量/查询计划验证；不要虚构每查询费用上限。

samples.contract: 按非索引字段查询并排序；返回1行却随表规模全表扫描；迁移漏掉关键索引。
使用适配谓词/排序的索引；本地测量多组数据分布下扫描量，阈值来自业务契约。
动态SQL/ORM无法展开，缺表规模、迁移或可测量数据库后端。

implementation.static: SQL AST predicates/order/LIMIT plus per-database committed indexes and hot call closure
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Actual DO SQL cursor rows and D1 local meta; SQLite plan probe separately labelled
implementation.unsupported: Dynamic ORM/SQL, unsupported syntax, complex joins/selectivity and production schema

rules.title: 大范围写入与冗余写放大
rules.candidate_trigger: UPDATE/DELETE范围变化；upsert、批量写、相同记录重复状态镜像。
rules.native_control_limit: Batch/upsert result idempotency does not imply zero write billing; indexes also incur writes.
rules.recommendation: 优先官方存储/行数计量和现有受支持限制；不要自动删除数据或关闭必要持久化。

samples.contract: 单行UPDATE的WHERE在重构中移除；无变化的数据在每次事件上重复upsert并维护多份状态。
唯一键限定写入；有界维护任务得到明确授权；重复事件的必要持久化与不必要重复写分开测量。
表规模与触发频率未知，或者数据库后端不明。

implementation.static: SQL AST whole-table UPDATE/DELETE on known database schema; hot vs maintenance entry
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Actual DO broad writes, low selectivity, repeated upsert rowsWritten
implementation.unsupported: General selective bounds, transactions, trigger/index amplification need workload evidence

rules.title: Cron/批处理没有持久化进度
rules.native_control_limit: Cron frequency limits triggers, not repeated per-job work or crash replay.
rules.recommendation: 原生Cron配置是触发源控制候选；需实施时查当前管理文档；不能据此取消DO Alarm。

samples.contract: 每次Cron读取相同首批记录，游标不提交；崩溃后再次执行无界重写。
持久化单调进度/去重；明确事务边界；故障注入后重复工作量有上限；任务完成停止处理。
检查点或事务实现由外部服务提供，无法获取契约。

implementation.static: Scheduled/alarm SELECT LIMIT + writes with no committed progress transition
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Bounded checkpoint/crash simulation and finite DO work across eviction
implementation.unsupported: Checkpoint transactions and external processing, arbitrary business progress semantics

rules.title: Queue→API→Queue形成新消息反馈环
rules.candidate_trigger: queue消费函数调用公共业务API/RPC，该目标存在send/sendBatch或异步入队分支。
rules.native_control_limit: max_retries and DLQ apply to one message, not new messages in the same logical task.
rules.recommendation: 优先平台单消息重试/DLQ配置，但明确其作用域；暂停投递不能阻止生产者继续发送。

samples.contract: 消费者保留async标志调用原入口；旧消息ack成功但创建新jobId并再次入队。
消费执行路径不再入队；或受控业务工作流的rootJobId/hops随新消息保留且有持久化边界。
消费者调用的外部endpoint不可分析，不能证明不产生新消息。

implementation.static: Consumer → same-repository cross-file producer → new send without preserved root/hops guard
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Bounded 20-step fresh-ID/ack feedback and bounded root/hops chain with real Queue test helpers
implementation.unsupported: External producers, DLQ replay semantics and real cloud Queue scheduling

rules.title: 重复投递与批处理副作用放大
rules.candidate_trigger: 整批处理、异常throw、手动retry/ack、外部副作用及重试设置变更。
rules.native_control_limit: At-least-once delivery and acknowledgement cannot promise exactly-once side effects.
rules.recommendation: 原生重试、ack、DLQ和pause优先；吞掉所有错误来减少费用不是安全修复。

samples.contract: 批次最后一条失败导致前面已成功的高成本副作用不断重做；重试耗尽另造新消息继续。
使用适当ack与幂等设计；已核实平台默认或显式重试上限；DLQ无自动无界回灌；重复工作预算清楚。
副作用在外部API且无幂等契约，无法界定重复代价。

implementation.static: Billable side effects plus explicit retryAll without per-item ack
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Bounded partial-success/write-before-ack/DLQ simulation using Queue test helpers
implementation.unsupported: Exactly-once side effects, external payments and production delivery behavior

rules.title: KV热路径list回退及分页失控
rules.candidate_trigger: 请求鉴权/查询失败进入KV.list；循环使用cursor进行分页。
rules.native_control_limit: KV cache is not a global strongly consistent limiter; reads, writes, lists are distinct.
rules.recommendation: 以KV原生计量/套餐额度为证据，应用缓存不能被当成全局强一致限流器。

samples.contract: 普通key miss后扫描整个namespace；分页cursor不更新或空页后错误重试。
热点使用定向key查找；必要的迁移扫描离线、有页数和总项数上限、检查点与失败策略。
key分布/命中率未提供，无法估计回退频度。

implementation.static: KV list in unbounded AST loop without cursor advance; bounded loops distinguished
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Actual local KV miss/list/cursor pagination; stuck cursor mutation
implementation.unsupported: Business miss cardinality, globally consistent admission and cross-region state

rules.title: R2备份同步/轮询操作放大
rules.candidate_trigger: Put/List/Head循环、Litestream等复制配置、备份/预览环境、重试周期。
rules.native_control_limit: Free egress does not imply free requests. ListObjects is Class A; storage/retrieval are separate.
rules.recommendation: 优先核实产品自身可用限制/访问控制；只关闭公共域名不能覆盖S3凭证与内部binding。

samples.contract: 无变更仍高频上传或列举；多个环境倍增；失败无退避且重试重新获得预算。
明确实际同步周期、变更检测、页数/分片数量、重试边界以及全部环境的每窗口操作数。
依赖默认sync interval但版本或生效配置未知。

implementation.static: Reachable fast timer/alarm with unconditional put/list; change guard candidate
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Actual local R2 put/list plus bounded frequency/environment arithmetic
implementation.unsupported: S3/public access, object-event loops, change-detection/retry semantics and live scope

rules.title: 公共入口、轮询和缓存位置误判
rules.candidate_trigger: 前端轮询/重连、公共GET/写API、Worker代理缓存、认证后才限流、业务高成本入口。
rules.native_control_limit: In-Worker cache hits still invoke the Worker; regional rate limits are not account-wide caps.
rules.recommendation: 优先当前套餐支持且覆盖实际入口的原生限流/WAF/缓存；报告workers.dev、直连或后台等未覆盖路径。

samples.contract: 每用户每秒轮询触发多次数据库操作；前端退避可被直接请求绕过；内部缓存命中被误当作消除Worker入口调用。
画出计费前后路径；适用的原生保护与缓存经过核验；用户/租户/全局预算作用域清楚，鉴权数据不泄露进公共缓存。
WAF/缓存/限流只在控制台设置，仓库无导出或核验证据。

implementation.static: Literal browser script served by configured assets + fast relative polling + costly Worker handler
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Static same-origin asset fixture and public entry gaps; no live WAF test
implementation.unsupported: Dynamic routes/templates, cache/WAF account state and general public traffic bounds

rules.title: 伪安全保证与不可执行的隔离声明
rules.candidate_trigger: 预算/CPU/retry/getAlarm/暂停/全局开关被用来证明安全，或代码生成虚构平台配置/API。
rules.native_control_limit: Budget alerts notify only. Test resets, CPU limits and queue pause are not a hard monthly cap.
rules.recommendation: 原生优先但不虚构能力；测试API不是生产API；真实缺口才建议最小代码边界，危险运行时操作不属于v1。

samples.contract: 报告将邮件预算告警称为硬上限；拿本地abortAllDurableObjects测试API当线上账户停用API；生产者未停却报告Queue费用归零。
每个控制都注明官方来源、版本/套餐、作用域、实际执行证据和残留风险；没有已核实原生能力时明确unknown/gap。
能力依赖企业合同/未公开功能或官方页面无法确认。

implementation.static: Structured false control guarantees and reachable test reset helper
implementation.agent: Mandatory semantic review with actual source locations and official context; static candidates are not complete coverage
implementation.local_tests: Five native scope falsification tests, signed false hard-cap schema rejection
implementation.unsupported: Plan/contract applicability, runtime control state and any production isolation
